description: This file contains unit tests for the onboarding flow logic in an Android application, specifically testing the canFinishOnboarding function under various connectivity scenarios.

classes.name: OnboardingFlowLogicTest
classes.description: A test class for validating the onboarding flow logic based on connectivity status.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyOperatorIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot finish when only the operator is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot finish when neither the operator nor the node is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyNodeIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot finish when only the node is connected.

methods.name: allowsFinishOnlyWhenOperatorAndNodeAreConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding can only finish when both the operator and the node are connected.
